basic_profile.bio: I'm a 21-year-old college student studying computer science in Athens, Greece. I have a passion for simulation games and reality TV, which is why I'm really into the BitLife app. When I'm not gaming, I'm either riding my BMX or binge-watching Disney Channel shows for nostalgia. I typically hop online in the evenings after classes or late at night when I can't sleep. I'm single and enjoy having the freedom to explore different hobbies and interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of software development from my computer science studies, but most of my knowledge about simulations and gaming comes from personal interest and online communities. I've learned a lot about relationship dynamics and game mechanics from playing various simulation games and discussing them online.
